items.en: Hwasong-11Ma-1 Details Reveal 9.8-Ton "Classical" Hypersonic Missile, Key Question Is Whether Pyongyang Transfers It to russia

items.en: Russia strikes Kyiv with drones by day, then Zircon and Iskander-M missiles overnight; Zelensky claims 60% of ballistic missiles intercepted
items.nl: Rusland valt Kyiv overdag aan met drones en 's nachts met Zircon- en Iskander-M-raketten; Zelensky claimt 60% van de ballistische raketten onderschept
items.sEn: Over roughly 24 hours on 23–24 September 2026, Russia struck Kyiv first with a daytime drone attack and then overnight with a combined missile and drone strike. items.en: Unknown North Korean KN-23 Variant Can Reach 60–70 km Altitude, Posing New Challenge for Patriot Systems
items.nl: Onbekende Noord-Koreaanse KN-23-variant haalt 60–70 km hoogte en vormt nieuwe uitdaging voor Patriot
items.sEn: Defense Express analyst Ivan Kyrychevskyi, citing Janes, reports that North Korea launched two KN-23 ballistic missiles on 20 September 2026. items.en: North Korea has fired around 150 ballistic missiles at Ukraine and is learning from each strike, Ukrainian intelligence says
items.nl: Noord-Korea heeft ongeveer 150 ballistische raketten op Oekraïne afgevuurd en leert van elke inslag, stelt Oekraïense inlichtingendienst
items.sEn: According to Euromaidan Press, roughly 150 North Korean KN-23 and KN-24 ballistic missiles have been fired by Russia at Ukraine since late 2023 (an estimate). items.en: Ukrainian Drone Takes Out Rare North Korean Type-75 Rocket Launcher
items.nl: Oekraïense drone vernietigt zeldzame Noord-Koreaanse Type-75 raketwerper
items.sEn: Ukraine's 40th Brigade destroyed a North Korean-supplied Type-75 rocket launcher with a strike drone, according to Defense Express, which cites video released by the brigade. items.en: Ukrainian intelligence: Russia to test new ballistic missile with ~800 km range, possibly by striking western Ukraine
items.nl: Oekraïense inlichtingendienst: Rusland wil nieuwe ballistische raket met bereik tot ~800 km testen, mogelijk op doelen in West-Oekraïne
items.sEn: Ukraine's military intelligence directorate (HUR) says Russia is preparing final tests of a new ballistic missile with a range of up to roughly 800 kilometers before the end of 2026.
